build_base_attention_module: build a BaseAttention module with multi-head attention using global, GNN, and regularization configs
create_qkv_projection: create Q, K, V projections by reshaping and permuting tensors into multi-head attention format
run_scaled_dot_product_attention: run scaled dot product attention on projected Q, K, V tensors with an attention mask
